title: Captain America Steve Rogers #15 16 Lot Marvel 2017 Secret Empire Red Skull
condition_description: Both covers clean and bright; spines and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
description:
Captain America: Steve Rogers #15 and #16 (2017), Marvel Comics, written by Nick Spencer - the lead-in to Secret Empire. $3.99 cover price each.

You get both issues:
- #15 (Jun 2017) - Gabriele Dell'Otto cover of Captain America vs. the Red Skull; art by Javier Pina and Ro Guinaldo
- #16 (Jul 2017) - "Secret Empire: Opening Salvo", Hydra cover; art by Kevin Libranda

Back covers: Marvel Mastercard ads.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
